stage: post-calibration method specification before reserved-clip pose access

clock.targets: 0.5,1.5,...,59.5 seconds in the unchanged source interval
clock.rule: Require exactly one ascending crossing in original row order for every target, counting ALL crossings before the age check; duplicates are retained. Require previous PlaybackTime<target<=current PlaybackTime, then current-target<=0.1s. First recorded PlaybackTime must be<=0.5s and the trace must reach60s. Return no pose series if any target is missing, stale or ambiguous. Even an out-of-age repeated crossing is ambiguous.
clock.wall_clock: Require finite nonnegative relative timestamps in nondecreasing original order; duplicate log timestamps allowed and reported.
clock.repairs: None: no sorting, prefix removal, interpolation, shifting, choosing first/last among repeated crossings, looping or stretching. A reversal that never crosses a required target is retained and reported, not silently deleted.
clock.meaning: Defines the uniquely bracketed recorded pose sample, not proof of the historical headset's displayed image or wall-time/media-time equivalence.

quaternion.normalization: Explicit unit normalization of selected valid samples; report maximum selected norm error; reject nonfinite, zero or out-of-tolerance values.

media.origin: Keep original strict zero-start gate; unresolved nonzero presentation origins remain ineligible until separately evidenced. No per-file shift inferred from other clips.

limits: Source adapter is conservatively specified and calibration-tested; full sixteen-clip source qualification remains unperformed. No perceptual, positive admission, population or controller-superiority claim.
